title: Night Roll .rollnotes.json (v2)
description: docs/annotations-v2.md — v1 plus a header (format/origin/stamp); notes keep the exact v1 per-entry schema.

format.description: Required from version 2 on. A version >= 2 document with any other (or missing) format is unreadable — the app opens it read-only and refuses to publish/overwrite it.

version.description: 1 (no format field) = the original flat shape. 2 = this schema. > 2 = a future format this app cannot read; opens read-only, refuses to publish/overwrite.

song.description: The song's base filename (no extension) — matches v1.

stamp.description: Epoch ms this file was saved — the cross-device freshness beacon (NIGHT-ROLL.md). Called 'saved' in v1; 'stamp' here so a v2 reader never confuses the two.

origin.description: Where this song comes from — structured form of the legacy 'forked from <path>' / 'moved from <path>' notes (docs/provenance-plan.md). Optional: absent on a file nothing has recorded provenance for yet.

from.description: Repo path this song was copied/forked from.

movedFrom.description: Repo path this song was moved from (its own identity continues; see moveComposition in index.html).

at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the origin was recorded.

notes.description: One entry per array element so the file still git-diffs line-per-change. Every entry is the SAME schema v1 writes.

anchor.description: [bar, beat]. beat omitted = 1. Anchors stay [bar, beat] — never raw ticks (docs/provenance-plan.md).

note.description: One annotation. 'type' selects the directive; its value field(s) are required for that type. No 'type' = a plain text note.

to.description: End anchor for a ranged note (section/chord spans, etc). Omitted beat = end of bar.

text.description: Plain prose note — only when 'type' is absent.

note.description: Attached comment on any typed directive or a chord (cnote); on type: analysis, the user's own answer; on type: songnote, the note's body.

item.description: type: analysis — the Analysis sheet prompt this entry answers, e.g. 'summary.what' (docs/plans/2026-10-05-analysis-sheet.md §2). One entry per item.

done.description: type: analysis — the user's own tick. Written only when true.

title.description: type: songnote — the song note's short one-line title, e.g. 'Sway'; unique per song (compared without case). The body is 'note'.

chord.description: type: chord — the symbol (lasso chord-namer vocabulary).

roman.description: type: chord — the Roman numeral the user entered, as typed (ASCII b/# accidentals: 'bVII', 'vi', 'ii°', 'V7', 'V/V'). Absent = none. Never derived by the app.

no5.description: type: chord — the user's 'no fifth' mark. Absent = not marked.

key.description: type: key — e.g. 'Bb', 'Gm', 'D dorian', or 'Bb?' (tonic-only, partial).

track.description: type: track or audio — the track name (or trN index).

voice.description: type: track — voice override: a built-in voice id, game:/sf2: instrument, or a patch (patch:<name>:<wave>:envA,D,S,R[:vibRate,Depth,Delay][:later segments], docs/annotations-v2.md).

loop.description: type: loop — the jump target as 'bar.beat'.

file.description: type: audio — the recorded clip's filename.

offset.description: type: audio — seconds into the file where this piece starts.

len.description: type: audio — seconds of the file this piece plays; absent = the rest.

local.description: type: audio — this device's local recording, never synced.

chop.description: type: chop — non-destructive trim in RAW capture coordinates.

ai.description: Present only on an annotation written by '✦ Annotate this song…' (an AI estimate, Normal mode, src/ask/annotate.js). Absent = the user's own. Any note type may carry it.

model.description: The model id that produced the estimate.

note.$comment: Strict for what THIS build writes. The app's reader is deliberately looser (docs/annotations-v2.md 'Forward compatibility'): an unknown field, or a whole unknown type, is kept verbatim and written back, never dropped.
